name: Rose Hill Mansion

location.text: Geneva (town of Fayette), Seneca County, New York

dates.note: Historic Geneva: 'built between 1837 and 1839, the earliest reference date for its completion is September 7, 1839'; the Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1839'; the node's exemplar year is 1837.

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 73001269; added February 6, 1973; designated NHL June 24, 1986 (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
refs.note: Read from the Wikipedia infobox, not from the National Register's own database, which was not opened for this building. Historic Geneva's own page gives the NHL designation as 1987; the two disagree by a year and neither is corrected here.
